title: Structure-Preserving Integration for Magnetic Gaussian Wave Packet Dynamics
summary: We develop structure-preserving time integration schemes for Gaussian wave packet dynamics associated with the magnetic Schrödinger equation. The variational Dirac--Frenkel formulation yields a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian system for the wave packet parameters, where the presence of a magnetic vector potential leads to a non-separable structure and a modified symplectic geometry. By introducing kinetic momenta through a minimal substitution, we reformulate the averaged dynamics as a Poisson system that closely parallels the classical equations of charged particle motion.
